name: Exp_2MoHLC
summary: This EA trades based on the 2MoHLC custom indicator, which generates a cloud from two moving averages. It supports two modes: cloud color change (trend reversal) and cloud breakthrough (price breaking through the cloud boundary), opening buy/sell positions accordingly with configurable stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于2MoHLC自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过两个移动平均线生成云带。支持两种模式：云带变色（趋势反转）和云带突破（价格突破云带边界），根据信号开仓做多或做空，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于2MoHLC指标生成的上下云带（UpValue和DnValue），通过两种模式判断趋势方向。在CloudColor模式下，当上轨大于下轨时判断为上升趋势，若前一周期上下轨交叉则产生买入信号；反之产生卖出信号。在Breakdown模式下，当收盘价突破云带上轨时做多，跌破云下轨时做空。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及趋势反转时的平仓信号（BUY_Close/SELL_Close）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，包含滑点保护和信号时间戳机制。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 2MoHLC indicator which generates upper and lower cloud bands (UpValue and DnValue) from two moving averages with different periods. In CloudColor mode, an uptrend is identified when the upper band is above the lower band, and a buy signal is generated when the bands cross from the previous bar; conversely for sell signals. In Breakdown mode, a buy signal occurs when the close price breaks above the maximum of both cloud bands, and a sell signal when it breaks below the minimum. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, as well as position closing on trend reversal signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot size and positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen) with slippage protection and signal timestamp mechanisms. The strategy uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are only calculated on new bar formation, preventing repeated trades on every tick.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio; negative value=fixed lot size

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 指标算法模式：云变色或云突破
parameters.description_en: Indicator mode: cloud color change or cloud breakout

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 双模式设计（云变色和云突破）提供灵活的交易策略选择
完整的开仓和平仓权限控制，可精细调整做多做空方向
使用IsNewBar机制避免逐tick重复计算信号，减少资源消耗
止损止盈参数完备，风险控制有基本保障
通过Recount标志处理数据复制失败，具备基本的容错机制
pros_en: Dual-mode design (cloud color change and cloud breakthrough) provides flexible trading strategy options
Complete open/close permission controls allow fine-tuning of long and short directions
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to avoid recalculating signals on every tick, reducing resource consumption
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control safeguards
Handles data copy failures via the Recount flag with basic fault tolerance
cons: 依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以完全评估风险
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置偏大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
没有交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
缺乏移动止损或保本止损机制，无法锁定浮盈
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with invisible core trading logic, making full risk assessment difficult
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large, potentially leading to significant single-trade losses
No trading session filter, may produce unfavorable fills during low liquidity periods
Lacks trailing stop or break-even mechanism, unable to lock in floating profits
Does not check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially opening duplicate positions
improvements: 增加移动止损功能，在价格有利移动时锁定利润
添加交易时段过滤和点差过滤，避免不利市场条件下开仓
增加同方向持仓检查，防止重复开仓导致过度暴露
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to lock in profits when price moves favorably
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable market conditions
Add same-direction position check to prevent duplicate openings causing overexposure

risk_points: 依赖外部库的仓位管理逻辑不可审查，存在未知风险
较大止损值（1000点）可能导致单笔重大亏损
无同方向持仓检查可能导致过度持仓
risk_points_en: Position management logic in external library is unauditable, posing unknown risks
Large stop loss value (1000 points) may result in significant single-trade losses
No same-direction position check may lead to overexposure
